cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.
